_comment: Build menu: the categories of the original's build menu with their buildings, in order (lists as in JSettlers' EBuildingsCategory, MIT). Buildings a people does not have are left out. tab: GUI images (file 03, large size) of the category button, normal and selected.
_panelTabsComment: The main tabs below the minimap (GUI images of file 03: [normal, pressed], drawn over the blue panel where its own tabs are) and the sub-menus in the dark bar below them (the build tab uses buildMenu). The sub-menus are only placeholders for now.
_soldiersMenuComment: Siedler > Krieger: GUI images of file 03 for the upgrade buttons per soldier type ([plain, plain dark, upgraded, upgraded dark]) and the arrows ([double up, up, down, double down]); weapon squares of the people's file for the recruitment rows.
_textButtonComment: Wide text buttons (Abreißen, Ja/Nein, the statistics screen …): the stone buttons of the original's menus before the game, GUI image 0 of file 02 (a sheet) – source rectangles [x, y, width, height] of the button up and pressed; border: the frame kept unstretched. statisticsBackground: the blue marble (GUI image of file 02).
_loadingScreenComment: Loading screen (the three helmets, 1024 × 768) shown while a game loads, [file, GUI image] per campaign: settlers orange, Mission CD green, Amazons purple (the Amazons' torso behind), game (free games) gold. Themes other than normal take gold (game), classic (settlers) or amazons always.
_titleScreenComment: Title screen per theme (normal: gold): the main menu picture per language (800 × 600; gold: the Gold Edition's, file 61, GUI 1 German, 2 English; classic: the original's orange, file 02; amazons: file 48), beside it a plain strip [x, y, width, height] of GUI image plain (the loading screen); the engraved buttons' colours [r, g, b] measured on the gold one, the others matched to their background; versionRight: where the version ends (default 773; classic: left of the picture's slogan under the logo). popup: the message box of the menus before the game ([file, GUI image], 401 × 201: text area, marble for the buttons below).
_settingsScreenComment: Settings screen: a background of the original's menus (file 02, GUI 14, 800 × 600: four small boxes and a title field at the top, a large dark area, a note field at the bottom), marble beside it (GUI 29); tabs in the four boxes: icons of the original's statistics menus ([bright, dark] GUI images of tabs.file).
_campaignScreensComment: Campaigns: choosing the side, per campaign on the original's background (800 × 600; background, marble: images of the screen's file or [file, image]) – heading field, per side its picture and name field [x, y, width, height], lit: [file, sequence, frame] of a brighter picture of the figures laid on the picture's rectangle under the mouse (without: a gold frame). Settlers: file 02, GUI 7 (the three helmets, a picture per people). Mission CD: file 60, GUI 4 (the three shipwrecked in the storm), the brighter figures in settler sequence 0; label: a text key for the name field instead of the side's name (with the level), wrapped; headingSize: the heading's text size (15). Amazons: file 48, GUI 1 (the Amazons on the cliff, the three peoples' army on the beach), the brighter figures in settler sequence 2, placed by correlation.
_missionScreenComment: Campaign: choosing a mission once one is accomplished, on the original's background (file 02, GUI 18, 800 × 600: a field for the heading, a large dark area for the list), marble beside it – [x, y, width, height].
_startScreenComment: Start screen on the original's map selection background: GUI images of file 02 – background (800 × 600, list, slanted preview window, panel), marble around it, rowBar (stone bar under the selected row), scroll bar groove (top, track, bottom); from the sheet (GUI image 0) the oval button up and pressed and the scroll handle – [x, y, width, height].
_buildingInfoComment: The building panel: GUI images of file 03 – the tear-down icon at the top right (a building collapsing in dust; 198-200 small to large), at the top left stop work (a house, 393-395) and go on (a hand, 192-194), on construction sites beside it the highest priority (gears, 195-197; given: gears with a red !, 378-380), finished buildings with a work area in the middle of the header the button to move it (its own icon of nested spectral rings, drawn in BuildingInfo.WorkArea - the atlas has no such glyph).
_marketComment: A market's panel (Handel - Land): GUI images of file 03 – the strip of route buttons [×1, ×2, ×3, destination] (372-374 small to large; 375-377 the same for sea trade, with a ship in front), all (∞) and none (0) for the chosen good.
_dockyardComment: A shipyard's panel: dock = GUI image of file 03 for setting the dock (a hammer with an arrow; 390-392 small to large). ships: per people [file, index] of the large ferry; the last twelve GUI images of each people's file are ferry, ferry dark, trade ship, trade ship dark, each small to large – shipSteps picks ferry, ferry dark (no dock yet), trade ship, trade ship dark.
_shipsComment: Ships in GFX file 36: four sequences per ship (deck, an empty one, the parts in front of the deck, the whole ship without sail; shadow k is ship k's), six frames each (SW, W, NW, NE, E, SE); the sails (player color in the torso) are 28-34, in the order of the ships. Per people the small one (barrels) as the ferry, the big one (cabin, open deck for the goods) as the trade ship – the Romans' checked in the game, the others by the same pattern. Asians and Amazons: which of 16-27 is whose is a guess; the Amazons have only one ship of their own (27, the trade ship), their ferry is the Asians' small one.
_warMachinesComment: War machines (people's soldier file): body = one frame per direction (SW, W, NW, NE, E, SE), wheels = 216 frames, 36 per direction, rolling over the body; fire = first of six sequences (per direction) of the firing; shot = the flying stone or ball (one sequence, turning), with shotPerDirection six sequences of a bolt. The gong walks: its body has six blocks of 12 frames like a settler's walk. icons: [file, first GUI image]: machine (three sizes), the same pressed, ammunition, ammunition pressed.
_statusIconsComment: Small black squares over units a spell works on (file, settler sequence per spell, one frame each; side by side when several work). Sequences 134/135 of file 1 (red circle, red !) mark very uneven and even more uneven ground for levelling, 136-138 (i, !, arrow) info texts – not used yet.
_spellMenuComment: The priests' spell menu: per people [file, index] of the large icon of the top spell; the spells' icons lie in the 24 GUI images before the ships, three sizes each (small to large), the menu's top spell last – each further spell three lower. Order and spells: menu in data/magic.json.
_professionsMenuComment: Siedler > Berufe: GUI images of file 03 – the up/down spinner of the shares, the find buttons ([all on the map, all on the screen, the next one]) and the convert buttons ([5, 1]).
_transportMenuComment: Waren > Warentransport: GUI images of file 03 for the buttons below the goods: store, do not store, highest priority, +1, -1, lowest priority.
_distributionMenuComment: Waren > Verteilung: the goods at the left, in this order; only those with at least two kinds of user for the people (construction sites, building types taking it) are shown.
_goodsGridComment: Siedler > Produktion, Waren > Lagerbestand: the goods, row by row, with their GUI icon ([file, index], the large size – from JSettlers' EMaterialType, MIT, whose base index is the small one; weapon: the people's own from soldiersMenu) and German name. Goods the people cannot make are dark.
_portraitsComment: Unit portraits in the stone frame (GUI images of the people's file, the large 40x60 one; the medium and small are the two before it), by animation type; WORKER: the specialists (Fachleute), THIEF: scout. From the carrier on the same distance in every file (digger +3, builder +6, worker +18, thief +51, geologist +54, healer +63, priest +69 – Asians +75, pioneer +72 – missing for Egyptians). soldiers: the first, then swordsman, pikeman, bowman of level 1, the same of level 2 and 3, three images apart. common: the same for every people (file 03, or [file, index]); FRAME: an empty frame, behind the figure of kinds without a portrait.
_settlersOverviewComment: Siedler > Siedlerstatistik: icons of file 03 for room (house), settlers needing room (hammer) and the total (arrow); the soldiers' icon is the people's sword (soldiersMenu.weapons). rows: the portraits below, by animation type.
_statusComment: Building info panel: the simulation's status text mapped to the key of the state shown (buildingStatus.* in data/lang). The first entry whose text is contained in the status wins; anything else counts as active. Military buildings show their soldiers instead.
